sql:
SELECT fished_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips 
WHERE yt > 0
GROUP BY fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy

SELECT boat, fished_date_doy, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_doy IN (287, 288, 289)
GROUP BY boat, fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, total_yt DESC
LIMIT 30
